Title: The Invasion of Artemis
Description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />To think that one of the Ancients walked among us all this time! Huh! And you managed to prevent her awakening Sutekh! <g id="male_ragepunchfistsdown" />Such chaos!
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_lookLeftBody" priority="high" />So you've heard the ominous words of the Huntress, have you? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Somehow, she sounds different, knowing she's an Ancient.

Title: The Invasion of Artemis
Description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It's often acts committed in desperation that lead to even more desperate consequences, but we console ourselves thus.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_lookLeftBody" priority="high" />So you've heard the ominous words of the Huntress, have you? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Somehow, she sounds different, knowing she's an Ancient.

Title: The Invasion of Artemis
Description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It's often acts committed in desperation that lead to even more desperate consequences, but we console ourselves thus.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_lookLeftBody" priority="high" />So you've heard the ominous words of the Huntress, have you? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Somehow, she sounds different, knowing she's an Ancient.

Title: The Invasion of Artemis
Description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_tiltheadRemember" priority="high" />It's often acts committed in desperation that lead to even more desperate consequences, but we console ourselves thus.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_lookLeftBody" priority="high" />So you've heard the ominous words of the Huntress, have you? <g id="female_lookConcern" />Somehow, she sounds different, knowing she's an Ancient.

Title: Into the Wilds
Description: Morgaine requests that you travel west in search of survivors and Hargest's rangers. Help whoever you can, bring back any survivors, and if possible find a means to investigate the horrors beyond the inner bramble walls.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, particularly with this revelation that Artemis may have some twisted intent for them.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We must discern the Huntress's full intentions, <g id="female_lookConcern" />however depressing that may be.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_lookConcern" />That was… frightening. Images of terror and evil creatures of legend... <g id="female_thinking" />were they hallucinations? Let us hope.

Title: Into the Darkness
Description: Morgaine once again needs our assistance breaking through into the lowland jungles for Captain Hargest, so that we can investigate the destroyed settlement of First Light. Help Hargest and her rangers make it down safely.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, you do that. I must consult Myrddin's tomes. Minotaurs, gorgons, massive beasts... this is unprecedented.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />If the survivor's memories are to be believed, atrocities beyond imagination are under way in the old settlement. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />We must get there, and with haste!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Luck was with us! I found a few rangers dazed by the spores, and I saw you helping one yourself… <g id="female_lookConcern" />I just hope they get back to camp.

Title: Survivalist's Revenge
Description: Hargest thinks we should investigate Dayspring Mills on our way to the settlement, and evidence suggests that Albert Riches may be fighting back. Travel into the overgrown village and search for whatever clues you can find.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nod1" />Sure enough, and he may have a grip on the situation at the settlement.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_cheerFisthigh" />We've got a foothold, and that's progress! <g id="female_crossarms" />Wouldn't be surprised to get a cheer when I tell everyone back at camp.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Welcome to the settlement of Elysian Wilds, <g id="female_shrugShort" />or what's left of it. <g id="female_bowDeep" />Constable Magistrate Riches, at your service... <g id="female_shrugShort" />whatever title you prefer.

Title: First Light, Last Stand
Description: Albert Riches needs reinforcements! Travel northwest to Tanglesnap Hollows where Taurus disposed a chunk of the spirit shrine, destabilizing its effectiveness. It may be a longshot, but forage for ingredients to repair the shrine and correct its power to allow our allies safe passage.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Ah, now there's smart thinking! <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I like it! <g id="male_explain" />The Huntress's pet minotaur smashed the shrine good though,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> sent stone work flying way out!
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I have to admit, things were starting to get a little dark both outside... and inside my head at one point. <g id="male_handheart" />It's been better since you arrived. Much better.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_laughCocky" />Well, that was a fight for the ages! I'd say after today, <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />we won't give the leaf lady another inch of this land!

Title: Abducted Artificer
Description: Survivalist Riches implores us for aid, saving his kidnapped friend Jihoon Kim. Kim was captured by Medusa in the initial invasion, but Riches recently spotted him being dragged east to Saircor, go rescue the Artificer if you can.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Not sure, but it didn't sound good. Jihoon Kim - <g id="male_explain" />the town artificer a mechanical genius - Artemis said she had a special project for Kim, and that's all I know.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I'm not the most trusting man. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Artificer Kim is the best friend I have. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You have to get him out of there.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />Even when I heard the sounds of battle, I hardly believed it possible. <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />I have been down here more days than I can count.

Title: Escaping The Ruins
Description: Jihoon Kim believes Medusa and Artemis stole an item of importance and stashed it at Portico Tideswallow. If the item is recovered, it may convince the Minotaur there is something sinister going on with Artemis and the Beast Lords.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, please don't ask for any more details. I worked on the machine for weeks, <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />and then I saw… only the beginning.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_hopeless" />I had given up hope of ever seeing a human face again. <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />I will never forget what I have endured.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Well done. You are indeed a formidable warrior, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />and I am deeply in your debt for my liberation.

Title: Maze and the Minotaur
Description: Kim asks that we boldly brave the Labyrinth of the minotaur Taurus, Northeast of the Ancient ruins, so that we may speak to him. Survive the deadly challenges within, and parley with the beastman if you can.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_think" />These Beast Lords with whom Artemis has forged an alliance would seem to be the final part of her plan.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />I… am so sorry… for my hand in aiding them with that Ancient device. <g id="male_outfitashamed" />I didn't know the purpose they intended until it was too late. It must be destroyed.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: So you see, I swear no allegiance to the Huntress, and I do not war with humanity, unless provoked.

Title: Lord of the Pride
Description: To forge an alliance with the Beast Lords we will first need to prove ourselves to them. Taurus suggests that we begin with the Lion Lord Shirzad to the north in Shirzad's Pride. Complete his challenge and gain an audience.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Beast Lords are primal powers, far beyond anything you or I can imagine. If they war, they will win.
InProgressResponse: Shirzad will grant you audience, but be wary on approach. His Pride will not tolerate trespassers.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You stood your ground with honor and fought with skill. Shirzad shall grant you an audience.

Title: The Proving Grounds
Description: Shirzad has listened to our plea and is willing to entertain our propositions for now. Travel west to Kurok's Anchorage and speak with the Gorilla Lord Kurok. Deliver Shirzad's message and gain an audience with the Lord.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: … If the Huntress seeks to trick us in this alliance, you will need no bargain, human. We will seek our own vengeance.
InProgressResponse: Be wary of Mahantaram; he has not been himself.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You are… no normal human. That is sure. You fought with great strength, and while you fought, I communed with Shirzad.

Title: Rage of the Mammoth
Description: Kurok has accepted our bid of peace for now, and is willing to reconvene with Shirzad over their fate on Aeternum. He now worries for his kin Mahantaram, the final Lord. Head east to the Trampled Lands, and face the mammoth.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Go quickly, for even as we speak, I stretch out to commune with him, and Mahantaram does not respond.
InProgressResponse: I sense strange changes within Mahantaram's soul, and I hear the thunder of his tribe resounding in the earth.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Soulwarden! How long has it been? Much has transpired since you left, and the magic in this land swirls into a maelstrom.

Title: Garden of the Gorgon
Description: Morgaine entreats us to retrieve the Tear of Gaea at all costs, but first we must defeat Medusa. Taurus already makes his way to her vile gardens south west of the ranger camp. Slay the Gorgon and drive her from these lands.
PlayerPrompt: "The Minotaur and I will defeat her."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />Then you will need protection from her gaze unless you want to be turned to stone! And you are fortunate to have a friend like Morgaine.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_worry" />I can only hope that Trahern and I have the magic and knowledge you will need to stop what Artemis has begun.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I do not revel in the suffering of others, <g id="female_nodRelieved" />but the cries of Medusa were like a fresh wind of hope.

Title: Arcana Aligned
Description: Trahern and Morgaine believe they may have devised a means of capturing Artemis and securing the Tear. Meet Morgaine up the road in the high mountains of what is now Scalefang Enclave to see what magic she has in mind.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />I hope so. We can only sow the seeds of possibility; nature must determine whether we harvest good fortune.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Go swift and stay strong. We will need your abilities in the battle to come. Defeating Artemis will take great effort.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Well done. What we have achieved here by siphoning these Ancient energies is very similar to what Myrddin did to first empower his Staff of Wizardry.

Title: One With Nature
Description: Morgaine directs us upward to the bloom above. With our Azoth Staff now empowered by the arcane energies channeled from Elafry Pyrgo we have but one more component to secure. Fight with Trahern, claim it, and finish the spell.
PlayerPrompt: "So the staff will be the key."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Precisely. Unlike the Archdruid, <g id="female_suppresslaugh" />your skills in comprehension are intact. Trahern does have a role to play however.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_crossarms" />Do not concern yourself. I am more than capable of battling my way safely to the tower.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />This goes beyond anything Myrddin ever attempted. <g id="male_nodProud" />I am proud to have assisted you.

Title: The End of New Eden
Description: Morgaine puts forth her final plea - capture Artemis and secure the Tear of Gaea from her grasp. With your allies at your back, ascend Elafry Pyrgo and battle the Ancient Artemis for the fate of the region, Aeternum, and the World.
PlayerPrompt: "What do I do with the Tear?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Heh. That is an excellent question, and I will need to think on it, <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />but it should not delay us now.
InProgressResponse: Even if we fail, Soulwarden, <g id="female_salute2finger" />I am proud of what we have accomplished together…<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" /> in scholarly terms, at least.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />We have averted the ascension of an Ancient, and yet there remains more to do. <g id="female_worry" />I fear what could befall the Beast Lords following their affliction.

Title: Secret of the Spores
Description: Master Alchemist Eadred has made a revolutionary discovery critical to the invasion. Investigate the strange spores blooming in the region and learn how you can use them to your advantage.\n(Requires: Harvesting 100)
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />I believe I have devised a method to render the toxic effects beneficial to us. <g id="male_gestureDownRight" priority="high" />It requires ingredients gathered from the plants themselves.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />It seems everything in this land wants to kill us. <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I suppose that shouldn't be so surprising.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Look at that, you’re glowing... <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />I jest, of course. Remember to keep your flask in tip top shape.

Title: Endangered by Artemis
Description: The Druid Keira implores you to aid the wildlife native to the region. The cries of animals call out from the depths of the jungle, and she feels their fear. Do what you can to keep them from becoming food for some new monstrosity.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: If we're quick about it. I have a special connection to the wild things. Their cries… they’re coming from the south.
InProgressResponse: We don’t know what other horrors were spawned by the transformation of this land. Be cautious.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: All is calm now. The animals sing with gratitude for their freedom. Thank you for giving them a second chance.

Title: A Beast No More
Description: Sebastian Vachon is pursuing a dangerous beast and needs your help finding it so he can study its origins. Follow its tracks through the region, defeat it, and bring its cerebrum back to the Druid.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I can find out. If you wish to help, slay the beast and bring me its brain. With that, I can divine the answer.
InProgressResponse: Some rangers claim to have encountered a creature such as this near the overgrown barrier deep within the mining town.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have the brain? Let me examine it…

Title: Firing Back
Description: Albert Riches, the survivalist of First Light left behind some battle plans and a note. How did he know we would be coming? In any case, we should help. Go into Charlottesburgh and complete the Survivalist's bombastic plan.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: The plant-men made a home of Dayspring. Dragged townsfolk there when it started… into the pods.
InProgressResponse: There is a hastily sketched diagram of a farmhouse surrounded by explosives. Stick figure Angry Earth are rushing towards it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_wipetear" />Scuse me, lad. Think I got something in my eye. <g id="male_ragepoundfist" />We lost a lot of good people when those leafy bastards showed.

Title: A Friend in Need
Description: Another potential survivor, James Oxen, appears to have dropped a check-list of supplies. There is a crude drawing of a cave on the back. Collect the supplies, find the cave, and protect the survivors.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
InProgressResponse: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_notsure" />I'm not seeing things? I thought I'd die here on this God-forsaken island. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You have my eternal thanks, mate!

Title: Tracking the Herd
Description: The Knight-Errant Fionn hopes we can render some assistance investigating the migratory behavior of the beasts moving between the nearby territory and the northern beastlands. Follow the clues and report back.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Migratory patterns to confirm they're heading for a choke point the Marauders picked out.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Travel south along the coast and try not to get spotted. These beasts are just like the rest of Aeternum's wildlife -<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> vicious and territorial.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />How was the investigation? You look like you ran into something dangerous.

Title: Plague for All Factions
Description: Ramla and her crew have come down with a mysterious illness. Something dangerous has awoken in these ruins and someone tough will be needed to investigate. See if you can solve the mystery.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I would prefer the surprises to stop. The symptoms are nothing particularly unique, but no treatments are working.
InProgressResponse: The Syndicate are held up here instead of setting up power for the Marauders.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: An alchemist told us our "curse" was some Ancient defense mechanism, but I dismissed the idea until the sickness faded.

Title: Defective Defenses
Description: Josephine and her Syndicate specialists were ambushed when they set off some form of automated defense system within Tideswallow. Now they need someone to deal with the Ancient Guardians and finish the repairs.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Got a knack for this do you? <g id="female_explainS" />If you gather up enough Ancient scraps, maybe you can fix the pylons. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Then you may need some Ancient tomes, for setting the runes.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />I don't mind waiting, but I can't say the same for the Marauders.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />All fixed? Us too. <g id="male_explain" />With the pylons repaired, our expert in Ancient machinery can attempt to gain control of the defenses.

Title: Factions United
Description: The flow of power has been restored to the Marauders at Saircor, and Keivan needs help with the final step of the operation. Fight off the Ancient Guardians and assist with the repairs so he can gain control of their defenses.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Looks can be deceiving, da? This will not be easy, friend. You have demonstrated mastery over Ancient Guardians. Show us Marauders another performance!
InProgressResponse: Every moment we delay, our foes continue their relentless advance. The man-beast to the north must not be allowed to amass his armies unchecked.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Haha! Run, cowards! Though I take great pride in Marauder victory over the Ancient Guardians, I am even more impressed by the strength of Aeternum united.

Title: The Heart of a Beast
Description: Pinned beneath a mysterious, rusted axe lies a note - addressed to you. It asks that you hold your judgment of the fabled Minotaur until you learn his story. Collect relics lost in the labyrinth, then speak with Marwa.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: “The Minotaur could be a force of wanton destruction, but he chooses not to be. He is hunted purely due to lies and falsehoods.
InProgressResponse: The note instructs you to find three relics within the labyrinth and deliver them to Marwa.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Taurus… Minotaur… Enkidu... he has gone by many names. I healed him after he was attacked in Weaver’s Fen decades ago. Now we fight side by side.

Title: Challenge of Character
Description: Marwa Shaheen has heard of your recent exploits, and knows more trials lie ahead. She wishes to offer a challenge to bolster your resolve. Visit Marwa and complete the time trial that she has prepared.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_itemGiveRight" />Take this torch and light the braziers I have placed across this land.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_order" />Your flame dwindles. Hasten to the braziers!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Masterfully done. You have no doubt gained favor with Taurus. <g id="female_giveitem" />Here is your reward.

Title: Gauntlet of Kings
Description: Shirzad believes you must increase in strength if you are to quell the rage of the tainted Beast Lords and their tribes. Return to his den at Shirzad's Pride and once again brave the grotto below.
PlayerPrompt: "No beast or man will stop me."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Then descend once more into the caverns of my kin, and defeat any who stand in your way. Do not relent and you shall be victorious.
InProgressResponse: The idle are not fit to lead.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Once again you prove yourself a mighty warrior. Perhaps you have the soul of a lion? You have my boon, human. Be welcome in my domain.

Title: Battle of the Beasts
Description: Barug of the Gorillas now stands in Kurok's stead, but without their Lord the tribe is in grave danger. Rally your fellow warriors to help the Gorilla tribe fight off an incursion by a champion of the Lizard Lord.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: With most of our allied Lords sequestered in the cavern, our tribe remains in great danger. Fight Gazsala in the bay. Fight with everything you have.
InProgressResponse: I struggle to maintain order in Nyhart's without Kurok. If Sirrussu spreads his malign influence here, others of their kind will surely invade.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My thanks, human. I offer you our boon. We weep for the Lords that are lost, and hope they may return to us in time. We need their guidance now more than ever.

Title: The Tribunal Highmound
Description: Manmosu, the new matriarch of the mammoth tribe, has taken refuge in a cave near the Tribunal Highmound to prepare for battle. Speak with her, and then prepare to assault the Highmound and its leaders.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: You think as I do, human. Focus on eliminating the leaders. Their contagion spreads quickly if they are left to prowl.
InProgressResponse: Maintain dominance or this land will dominate you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Impressive. I wish more within the herd had your conviction. It’s time to face the Lords within their new domain.

Title: Medusa's Monstrosities
Description: Johannes Metzger needs assistance investigating the sinister magic Medusa had been channeling in Scalefang Enclave. Reach out to the rogue scientist, help him gather samples, and work with the mysterious technology there.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Limbs. Guts. Brains. What else? You've skinned a deer before, yes? It's like that, but keep the bits you'd throw out.
InProgressResponse: You will not find the Hercyne by nettling me further, assistant. Get moving!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You have an uncanny aptitude for dissection. These samples are perfect! By studying these component parts I'll learn the intricacies of merging with Angry Earth.

Title: Medusa's Magic
Description: Johannes Metzger has even grander ambitions. Too grand to accomplish alone. Find him in the dark village and Help him with his final tasks, and he promises to share part of the credit for whatever he learns.
PlayerPrompt: "I'm as ready as I'll ever be."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That's the spirit! There are pylons like mine scattered around Scalefang Enclave.
InProgressResponse: Hop to, assistant! You know what they say about idle hands…
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: My Syndicate cluster warned me not to rush progress… I believe I understand now.

Title: The Siege of Light's Crown
Description: Ranger-Captain Hargest has advanced into inner Light's Crown to establish a perimeter, but she needs assistance. Help the rangers restock their munitions, bolster their defenses, and fend off attacks.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_gestureLeft" />We can use these barricades to create a choke point. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />We need to funnel the enemy into cannon range.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_convince01" />Once this cannon is operational, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />we will command the battlefield.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_compliment" />Excellent work! We've got a much stronger foothold here now. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Your quick thinking saved the day.

Title: Essence of Evil
Description: Heinrich Gauss has been dispatched to investigate the dark energy pouring out of Elafry Pyrgo and assess its potential danger to the humans of Aeternum. Help him to gather samples using his proprietary capture devices.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />You are far better equipped for the job…<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" /> Take my latest creation with you.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />You mustn't linger long. I want to capture the storm's full ferocity.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Were you successful in collecting the… <g id="female_lookConcern" />you look like you’ve seen a ghost. What happened up there?

Title: The Savage Divide (Expedition)
Description: The time has come to face the Beast Lords lost within the Savage Divide. Manmosu asks that we act as her champion, lest she risk infection by going herself. Gather your greatest allies, descend into the Divide, and defeat the Lords.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Unfortunately, he isn’t the only Beast Lord within the depths of the Highmound Caverns. The gorilla lord Kurok is inside as well.
InProgressResponse: Stay vigilant. You may have defeated Mahantaram before, but the foulness festering within him makes him unpredictable.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can feel his grip weakening on the herd. With time, the power he holds over us will diminish.

Title: Among the Statues
Description: Dame Edith Henrietta Shackleton has gotten herself into a bit of a situation in the maze. She requires help acquiring antiquities that have been turned to stone.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodProud" />I'm no dunce. I studied the Classics, and have an encyclopedic knowledge of mythology.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_impatient" />Have you recovered those artifacts yet? I'm getting tired from holding this position.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_compliment" />Splendid work! Just splendid! Imagine, this vase, if it hasn't been turned to stone, would have been as fragile as an eggshell.

Title: Containing the Contagion (Expedition)
Description: Archdruid Trahern has been hard at work researching methods for combating the magical plants spreading throughout the Savage Divide. He needs your assistance planting his newly created seeds within the depths of the cavern.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />We use Medusa’s magic against her. These seeds will absorb the taint and purify it before bursting into pristine flora.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_disagreeRighthandout" />Be careful, there are many infected creatures inside the cavern. If at all possible, try to give them a swift end. <g id="male_shakehead" />They've already suffered enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I’m glad you made it back safely. The seeds should prevent new infections from spreading.
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Ah, you have done well, child of dust… <g id="female_lookConcern" />though I fear evil will soon bloom again within these walls… <g id="male_outfitproud" />on that day, I hope you rise to defend the green once more.
